changelog:
Initial release of the AITOP skill.

- Provides free, anonymous access to all AITOP AI news updates and daily digests—no API key or MCP server needed.
- Requires a real User-Agent header for all `/api/public/*` requests.
- Supports querying AI updates by time window, category, keywords, and daily issues with clear endpoint mapping.
- Implements strict display templates for concise, user-friendly output.
- Enforces rules to avoid misuse, over-fetching, or incorrect routing of queries.
- All news results source URLs are retained; AI-generated summaries shown only when available.
